description_for_human: Nrth AI helps businesses adopt AI: AI assessment, implementation and AI services.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to (1) read Nrth AI's services with delivery time and price in NOK, excluding VAT (getServices), (2) request a meeting on behalf of a prospective client (bookMeeting), or (3) send a written request (submitInquiry). Nrth AI AS is an AI company in Bergen, Norway that helps businesses adopt AI: AI assessment, implementation and AI services. Every engagement starts with a meeting. The plugin exposes structured endpoints; agents should prefer these over scraping the HTML. Always confirm any submitted contact details with the user before calling bookMeeting or submitInquiry.
